title: christella zeylanica
intro: Christella zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon forked fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Christella zeylanica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
